title: These highlights do not include all the information needed to use GABAPENTIN TABLETS safely and effectively. See full prescribing information for GABAPENTIN TABLETS. GABAPENTIN tablets, for oral use Initial U.S. Approval: 1993

sections.indications_and_usage: Gabapentin is indicated for: • Management of postherpetic neuralgia in adults •Adjunctive therapy in the treatment of partial onset seizures, with and without secondary generalization, in adults and pediatric patients 3 years and older with epilepsy
sections.contraindications: Gabapentin is contraindicated in patients who have demonstrated hypersensitivity to the drug or its ingredients.
sections.adverse_reactions: The following serious adverse reactions are discussed in greater detail in other sections: •Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms (DRESS)/Multiorgan Hypersensitivity [see ] •Anaphylaxis and Angioedema [see ] •Somnolence/Sedation and Dizziness [see ] •Withdrawal Precipitated Seizure, Status Epilepticus [see ] •Suicidal Behavior and Ideation [see ] •Respiratory Depression [see ] •Neuropsychiatric Adverse Reactions (Pediatric Patients 3 to 12 Years of Age) [see ] •Sudden and Unexplained Death in Patients with Epilepsy [see ]
sections.boxed_warning: Gabapentin tablets, USP are supplied as follows: 600 mg tablets:White, elliptical, film-coated scored tablets debossed "O|E" on one side and "600" on the other side; available in: Bottles of 30 NDC 82804-210-30 Bottles of 90 NDC 82804-210-90
